excerpt.zh: 我们真是失望透顶啊，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你们许诺要阻止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]的一切不当行为，现在却看到他们仍然肆意妄为、横行霸道。我们曾以为你们能够阻止他们，但现在看来，是我们搞错了。
excerpt.en: We are most disappointed, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. Despite your promise to end their evil practices, the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] continue to purge and slaughter at will. We thought your species one of great promise, but perhaps we were mistaken.

texts.zh: 我们真是失望透顶啊，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你们许诺要阻止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]的一切不当行为，现在却看到他们仍然肆意妄为、横行霸道。我们曾以为你们能够阻止他们，但现在看来，是我们搞错了。
texts.en: We are most disappointed, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. Despite your promise to end their evil practices, the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] continue to purge and slaughter at will. We thought your species one of great promise, but perhaps we were mistaken.

texts.zh: 请收下这份礼物，作为[Root.GetName]对[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]服务的奖赏。你们会发现这份奖励绝对算得上丰厚。
texts.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], we have decided to grace your empire with a gift of resources as a token of our esteem. Do not squander our generosity or take our favor for granted.

texts.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们的种群真可谓是宇宙中很有价值的存在。为了证明对你们的尊重，我们决定赠与你们一份包含着宝贵矿物与其他资源的大礼。
texts.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], your species is a most worthwhile addition to the galactic community. As a token of our esteem, we have decided to bestow on you a generous gift of valuable minerals and resources.

texts.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]！你们的种族十分杰出，而你们对教义的坚持也令人敬佩。出于我们无尽的仁慈，请收下这份资源作为礼物。
texts.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName]! Your species is a worthy one, and your adherence to the immutable doctrines of faith are to be commended. Accept this gift of resources as a token of our boundless benevolence.

texts.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们的技术效率太低了，让我们都看不下去了。作为我们[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]的麾下干将，我们决定跟你分享我们对宇宙的一些见解。我们并不是对任何物种都这样做，所以一定要继续对我们保持有用——忘恩负义，对一个小孩来说是不需要的特质。
texts.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], the sheer inefficiency of your technology pains us. As you are a valuable client to the [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName], we have decided to share with you some of our understanding of the universe. This is not something we do for just any species, so be sure to continue to be of use to us - ingratitude is not a desirable trait in children.

texts.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，我们对你们停滞不前的科技发展投入了长足的关注。照你们目前的进度，恐怕在有生之年是没有办法展现全部的潜力了。为了对你们进行帮助，我们会将一个[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]的科学知识数据库赠与你们。你们绝对会发现，其中的内容对你们非常有用。
texts.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], we have observed your lack of technological progress with concern. At your current pace, we fear that you will never reach your true potential before you wipe yourselves out or are conquered by a more advanced species. In order to help you along, we will transfer a data cache of [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] scientific knowledge. You will no doubt find its contents to be of invaluable worth to your empire.

texts.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]！你们的种族十分杰出，而你们对教义的坚持也令人敬佩。出于我们无尽的仁慈，请收下这神圣的知识作为礼物。
texts.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName]! Your species is a worthy one, and your adherence to the immutable doctrines of faith are to be commended. Accept this gift of sacred knowledge as a token of our boundless benevolence.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]，作为[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]的客户，你们的舰队实力也会反映我们的战斗军力。可是你们的飞船还不够强大。为此我们特决定将我方闲置的一队护卫舰飞船赠送给你，以确保你们的安全。

我们已经用较为简单的部件替换了其中一些较为复杂的部件，以方便你们操作。其余的部件也安装了防拆解设备，所以请勿拆卸。因为这其中的内部构造对你们来说可能太过复杂。
texts.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName], as a [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] client the state of your fleets also reflects on us, and those crude hulks you call "warships" reflect very poorly indeed. To this end we have decided to gift you a squadron of surplus escort ships that should look most impressive to the other savages you regularly interact with.

We have replaced some of their more advanced components with cruder devices so that you are not overly confused by their operation, and the rest have been fitted with anti-tinkering devices, so do not attempt to analyze or disassemble the ships. You would be unlikely to understand their inner workings regardless.

texts.zh:
我们[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]认为，为保护宇宙的平衡与种群的多样性，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的存续是十分重要的。但我们担心的是，你们的舰队实力不足以和其他具有侵略性的种群抗衡。为了帮助你们进行自卫，我们决定将闲置的一队护卫舰飞船赠送给你。

我们已经用[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]较为熟悉的科技部件替换了其中一些较为复杂的部件，以方便你们操作。其余的部件也安装了防拆解设备，所以请勿拆卸。
texts.en:
We [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] believe that [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are an important species for maintaining the balance and biodiversity of the galaxy, but we worry that your fleets are simply too weak for you to be able to stand against other, more aggressive species. To help you defend yourselves, we have decided to gift you a squadron of surplus escort ships.

We have replaced some of their more advanced components with technology that should be more familiar to [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], so you should have no trouble operating them. Also, please do not attempt to analyze or disassemble the ships, we would not wish you to hurt yourselves!

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]！我们的先知说你们的种族将在信仰之路上扮演重要的角色。为了确保你们能够胜任，我们决定将一支闲置的小型护卫舰舰队赠送给你们，应该足以保护你们的安全。

不要胡乱改造舰船上的系统，尽管它们对我们来说是老旧型号，可仍远远超出你们当前的理解能力。
texts.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]! We have consulted the oracles and determined that your species has an important role to play in the great undertaking of the faith. To ensure that you can carry out this task, we have decided to gift you a squadron of surplus escort ships that should be more than adequate to destroy any primitive fleets of the other lesser races that might stand in your path.

Do not be tempted to tamper with the ships' systems, they may be older models of ours, but are still far beyond your current level of intellectual development.

texts.zh: 来自[From.GetName]的尊贵[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]，我们认为你们是一支具有巨大潜力的种群。虽说你们年纪尚轻，却似乎能够理解生物与社会多样性的重要性，在面对不同的生物与社会时不会尽全力压制或进行摧毁，反而会予以理解和接受。不幸的是，并不是所有年轻种群都具有这种智慧。尤其是[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]，他们一直在排除异己。我们不便直接进行干涉，所以希望能够将阻止恶行的任务交给你方。对他们发起攻击，阻止他们进行人口净化。我们将感激不尽。
texts.en: Honorable [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment] of the [From.GetName], we believe you to be a species of great promise. Though you are still young, you seem to understand and value the importance of biological and societal diversity who seek to understand and accept that which is different, rather than suppress and destroy it. Unfortunately, not all of the younger races are so wise. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName], in particular, appear to take pride in "cleansing" the galaxy of all forms of life they deem unsuitable. While we cannot intervene ourselves directly, we would like to charge your government with the task of bringing an end to their evil deeds. Attack them and force them to ban the practice of purging, and we will be most grateful indeed.

label.zh: 我们会制止错误行为的！
label.en: We will stop any further atrocities!
We do not wish a conflict with the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName].

texts.zh: 你好，年轻的[From.GetSpeciesName]。前一阵我们要求你们阻止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]的人口净化行为。目前看来，我们的要求已经没有必要了，因为[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName]已经下令禁止了这种活动。不知这是出于他人的胁迫还是自愿为之，反正已经没有必要对他们进行攻击了。
texts.en: Greetings, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. A while ago we tasked you with ending the practice of purging in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. It appears our request is no longer necessary, as the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have already banned the practice. Whether forced to by others or electing to do so themselves, there is no longer a need for aggressive action against them.

texts.zh: 这是怎么回事，[From.GetSpeciesName]？！你是想开玩笑吗？！你们不仅没能制止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]的错误行为，居然还打算效仿他们！作为正义的一方，我们绝不会姑息。
texts.en: What is this, young [From.GetSpeciesName]?! Do you think to mock us?! Not only do you fail in stopping the atrocities in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName], you have now elected to legalize those very same practices in your own empire! Know that we will not be made fools of. There will be repercussions for this, mark my words.

texts.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们要提醒你[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]正在做着危险的事情。[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName]已经开始研究异端科技，不断地制造出更加复杂的人工智能以制造出真正拥有自我意识的机器。我们曾目睹过这种研究的下场，并觉得有义务警告你，这不仅威胁到他们自己，也威胁到其他种族。建议你们主动出击，阻止他们进一步的研究。
texts.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! This is is a message to inform you of a dangerous development in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have begun to delve into heretical technologies, creating ever more complex artificial intelligences in pursuit of truly self-aware machines. We have seen where this path leads and feel it is our duty to warn you of the danger this poses not only to their own souls, but to those of all the younger races. We advise you to use your military might to attack them and force them to place a ban on any further such research.

label.en: We do not wish a conflict with the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName].

texts.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！尽管我们发出了警告，你们仍未对[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]进行的不当实验采取任何行动。看来你们并不在意自己的未来啊。
texts.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Despite our warnings, you have elected to do nothing about the heretical research being carried out in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. It appears your species may not be worth saving after all.

texts.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们已经不需要你们的协助来阻止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]进行不当实验了，因为那个帝国已经禁止了进一步的人工智能实验。尽管你们没能做出贡献，但至少这个威胁已经不复存在了。
texts.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Your assistance in ending the heretical research carried out by the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] is no longer needed, as a ban has already been placed on all further machine intelligence research in that empire. While you did not play any part in doing so, at least this threat to the spiritual well-being of the galaxy is dealt with.

texts.zh: 你们是瞧不起我们吗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？！难道你们以为我们不会注意到，在同意终结[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]进行的不当实验后，你们自己却开始进行了同样的实验！？我们无法容忍你们这样阳奉阴违的做法。准备迎接我们的回应吧。
texts.en: Do you think us fools, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?! Do you think we would not notice that, after agreeing to end the heretical research in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName], you yourselves would begin to pursue the very same lines of research?! We will not be mocked by worthless little savages that have barely even mastered the atom. Prepare yourselves for our response.

texts.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]要求我们制止正在[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]发生的错误行为。我们需要对他们开战，强迫他们结束种群消灭的行径。
texts.en: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] have asked us to stop the ongoing atrocities in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. We will need to make war on them and force them to end their genocidal practices.

title.zh: 任务：阻止人工智能研究

texts.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]要求我们制止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]开发智慧型人工智能的尝试。我们需要对他们开战，强迫他们禁止任何对人工智能的进一步开发。
texts.en: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] have asked us to stop the attempts by [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] to develop sapient AI. We will need to make war on them and force them to ban all further AI research.
